title: The Pullman house's Prairie Avenue trees stand where the photograph shows them
items: Along Prairie Avenue in front of 1729 Prairie, four parkway trees now stand where a c. 1900 photograph of the house puts them: from the house's north end to the 18th Street corner, where the last one stands beside the lamp post. The three trees guessed there before stood between them.
An 1890 printed view of the house shows the portico and corner trees too, as young staked saplings.
